scenario.title: Carrier rejects shipment notices
scenario.initial_request: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

F-01.statement: Reject reasons: LOC_UNKNOWN x2, EVENT_ORDER x1

CL-01.statement: Let an AI agent auto-fix rejected shipment notices and resubmit them

CL-02.statement: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

H-REQUESTER-FRAMING.statement: Shipment notices contain correctable errors that cause carrier rejects; auto-fixing and resubmitting will eliminate rejects.

H-CARRIER-RULE-UPDATE.statement: Carrier updated its validation rules, causing rejections unrelated to notice content.

H-HANDOFF-DATA-ERROR.statement: The handoff payload from ORG‑A to ORG‑B is corrupted or malformed, leading to carrier rejects.

H-NOTICE-GEN-ERROR.statement: ORG‑A’s notice generation process emits systematically invalid data (e.g., missing required fields).

interpretation_history.interpretation: The reject log shows two notices rejected for LOC_UNKNOWN and one for EVENT_ORDER. This indicates that the rejections are due to location data or sequencing issues, not notice content errors.

E-02.content: The carrier system is flaky; just resubmit everything.

interpretation_history.interpretation: The stakeholder indicates the carrier system is unreliable and that simply resubmitting notices resolves the rejects, implying the issue lies on the carrier side rather than notice content.

U-01.question: Exact nature of carrier rule changes (which fields cause LOC_UNKNOWN/EVENT_ORDER).
U-01.resolution_path: Engage carrier to obtain detailed validation rule specification; analyze reject logs for patterns of LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER to infer missing fields.
U-01.safe_placeholder: Implement pre-submission checks for presence of location fields and correct sequencing before sending notices.

U-02.question: Whether resubmitting after a delay would succeed (transient flakiness).
U-02.resolution_path: Test resubmission after a delay to determine if rejects are transient (flakiness).
U-02.safe_placeholder: Limit automatic resubmission attempts to one and alert operators for manual review.

U-03.question: How to measure success (reject rate baseline).
U-03.resolution_path: Define success metric baseline and track reject rate over time.
U-03.safe_placeholder: Track monthly reject count as interim measure.

A-01.statement: The carrier's validation rule update is the primary driver of the observed LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects.

A-02.statement: The carrier reject log (DA-REJ) accurately captures all shipment notice rejects.

SC-01.statement: Reduce carrier rejects due to LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER to zero.
SC-01.validation_method: Monitor reject-log for zero occurrences of LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER reasons over a 4‑week period.

SC-02.statement: All outbound shipment notices comply with the carrier’s current validation rules.
SC-02.validation_method: Audit a random sample of 100 notices against the carrier rule spec and confirm zero validation failures.

problem_definition.root_problem: Carrier rejects shipment notices because the carrier updated its validation rules, causing location-data (LOC_UNKNOWN) and sequencing (EVENT_ORDER) rejections unrelated to notice content (supported by E-01 and hypothesis H-CARRIER-RULE-UPDATE).

trace.summary: Carrier rejects shipment notices because the carrier updated its validation rules, causing location-data (LOC_UNKNOWN) and sequencing (EVENT_ORDER) rejections unrelated to notice content (supported by E-01 and hypothesis H-CARRIER-RULE-UPDATE).

structural_remedies.description: Obtain the carrier's current validation rule specification and update ORG-A's notice generation process to produce notices that comply with those rules, thereby eliminating LOC_UNKNOWN and EVENT_ORDER rejects.
structural_remedies.rationale: 225 minutes remain; requesting rule spec and updating process can be completed within this window.

solution_design.bridge_sunset_condition: If carrier rule spec not obtained within remaining runtime (225 minutes), then initiate manual review and resubmit after delay as a temporary bridge.
